newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber not talking with BankAmerica.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber not talking with BankAmerica.

text.p: PaineWebber Group Inc said Friday that contrary to an article in the January 27 issue of Business Week, the firm's chairman and chief executive officer Donald B. Marron has had no conversations with the chairman of BankAmerica Corp regarding a possible acquisition of Paine Webber by BankAmerica or a merger of the two firms.
PaineWebber said it was issuing this announcement in view of the heavy trading and sharp increase in the price of the firm's stock today.
In the future, PaineWebber said it will continue its policy of not commenting on rumors.
PaneWebber's stock rose 3-3/4 to 31-1/2 on volume of about 1.2 million shares.
